gates.requiredScope: Manifest cardinality, one decision per target, 17-claim assessments, Documentation Impact completeness, delivery boundaries and unchanged propagation target set
gates.rationale: Feature-local deterministic validation is required without changing shared workflows.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: The fleet-adoption schema, target set or acceptance contract changes.

gates.requiredScope: Local Markdown links, language partners, learner package and text-first accessibility
gates.rationale: Feature evidence and any adopted target guidance serve learners and maintainers.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Changed paths, language partners or provider documentation workflows change.

gates.requiredScope: Homogeneity, Documentation Impact, PowerShell analysis, whitespace, secrets, statistics and Spec Kit integrity
gates.rationale: Repository policy requires these gates for feature evidence and documentation changes.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: The changed-path inventory or repository quality policy changes.

gates.requiredScope: Existing Maintenance TUI restore, build and tests prove the documentation-only feature did not disturb the operational project
gates.rationale: Existing provider regression gates remain mandatory even when executable files are unchanged.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: The Maintenance TUI project or provider workflow scope changes.

gates.requiredScope: Every adopted target runs its repository-native documentation, A11Y, security, agent-parity and exact-head review gates
gates.rationale: A changed target must prove its own repository contract; unchanged targets have no delivery row.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: No target is adopted or a target's native gate contract changes.

gates.requiredScope: DocFX generation and browser Playwright/Axe validation
gates.rationale: Level 0 has no DocFX or browser documentation test project; target-native web checks apply only if an adopted target changes such content.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Level-0 DocFX/generated HTML enters scope or an adopted target changes browser documentation.

gates.requiredScope: SBOM, VEX, SLSA, OpenSSF Scorecard, AI-SBOM and dependency evidence
gates.rationale: No dependency, package, release artifact or AI runtime change is permitted.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Dependency, package, build, release or AI-runtime scope changes.
